actualFindings: Historical helper validates actual current dynamic signature and a single fixed already-Aux entitlement group, but Gate also relies on environment approval and original interposer symbols; it is not a clean native migration producer.
Historical inspect performs exact omitted-group attributes-only DP queries and returns status/group hash, not row data or durable ownership.
Current selected dev policy authenticates Aux-v2 selection fields; using it as implicit authorization for historical source capture would widen its contract.
Fresh-only authenticated policy/home cannot be cast to existing-home migration custody; fresh guard owner explicitly refuses unknown legacy parent state.
ExistingTerminalCskHandoff removes caller DK but remains external captured terminal consumer; no source row provenance or process custody is gained.

smallestRequiredNativeProducer.owner: real early native existing-home migration coordinator, before profiles/Node/children receive the home
smallestRequiredNativeProducer.authority: separately authenticated legacy migration resource with exact approved home/scope/source physical binding and actual current signed host/group entitlement validation
smallestRequiredNativeProducer.closedCohort: real retained native process/worker/profile close-and-drain handles plus descendant/peer lifetime, not environment flags, advisory lock, disk JSON or caller PID
smallestRequiredNativeProducer.query: single exact fixed prefixed old-selector DP read returning attributes+Data; validate returned service/account/group against authenticated fixed policy and actual effective entitlement; no fallback group/enumeration/owner product selector
smallestRequiredNativeProducer.result: typed missing/unavailable/invalid/data observations only, bound to genuine retained native coordinator; unavailable never absence
nextConsumers: four-row inspect/recovery archive + additive create-only transaction
terminal preserved authority + DurableCapturedCskHandoff paired by ExistingTerminalCskHandoff

cannotImplementCustodyFromCurrentSources: No existing-home native custody producer exists in current guard. A fabricated private-init token based only on these public/static observations would falsely promote them to migration admission.
